defs.def: a type of soft white stone 白垩
a substance similar to chalk made into white or coloured sticks for writing or drawing （白色或彩色的）粉笔

ex.s: In primary school, I learned to write using chalks.
ex.t: 在小学里，我学会了用粉笔写字。

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画创作的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

chunks.cn: 较喜欢白色或彩色的）粉
